tldr: Lilith in Leo: the suppressed need to be seen and to shine
body: Lilith in Leo: the suppressed need to be seen and to shine. Where you reclaim creative power and unapologetic self-expression. Watch: ego and the demand for attention. Defiant self-expression: you refuse to dim, hide, or perform for approval. A creative, expressive self that was likely suppressed or shamed in a family uneasy with that much spark. Unowned, it folds into a quiet, withheld version of you; owned, it reclaims bold creativity and tends to find its home in creative, visionary, or caring work.
business: Owned, this is bold, magnetic authenticity.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes a hunger for validation; unchecked, attention-seeking and pride.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
